I reject the hypothesis. A two-proportion test (chi-square, no continuity correction) gives p ≈ 0.0016, below the 5% significance level.

The share answering "do not know enough to say" differs by education:

| Group | "Do not know" | Total | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| College graduates | 104 | 438 | about 23.7% |
| Non-college graduates | 131 | 389 | about 33.7% |

ANSWER: reject
